accepted_claim: An infinite minimal exchangeable tail-trivial faithful tracial sequence with separable predual whose canonical pair intersection is eight-dimensional while its prescribed singleton is four-dimensional; no factorization preserves those singleton algebras.
enlargement: A permutation-covariant eight-dimensional singleton enlargement repairs the factorization; existential enlargement formulations are explicitly excluded from the negative conclusion.
remaining_gap: Historical Conjecture 5 says gives rise without explicitly requiring singleton preservation. The present result does not settle a formulation allowing arbitrary enlargement.
